project_title: The Notice Board — South Africa's Intelligent Opportunity Operating System
positioning: Editorial-premium South African opportunity discovery platform combining high-trust verification, national opportunity intelligence, and sophisticated editorial styling.

principles: Fusion over Imitation: Combine Financial Times authority with Stripe product polish and Linear density
Emotion First: Evoke career empowerment, security, and national progress without cheap AI slop
Content is King: Newspaper-grade hierarchy with high readability and structured data transparency
Trust Architecture: Transparent verification scores, official source auditing, and scam protection badges

type_scale.h1_hero: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-serif tracking-tight leading-[1.15]
type_scale.h2_section: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-serif font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100 tracking-tight
type_scale.h3_card: text-lg sm:text-xl font-sans font-semibold text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100 leading-snug
type_scale.body: text-base sm:text-sm font-sans text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300 leading-relaxed

colors.theme: Light warm off-white default with rich midnight blue branding + dark mode toggle

required_screens_and_components: Mega Navigation Bar with dark logo badge, category shortcuts, search input, and high-trust status counter
Mobile Bottom Navigation Bar with quick access to Home, Search, Saved, Tenders, and Alerts
Cinematic Hero with Live Opportunity Pulse (counter for active jobs, learnerships, tenders)
Universal Search Bar with Province filter, Opportunity Category selector, and Remote toggle
Discover by Goal Pathways (Entry Level / Youth, Skilled Professional, Enterprise Tender, Bursary)
Closing Soon Urgency Ticker with dynamic countdown badges
Opportunity Feed with slide-over/sticky filter rail and layout mode toggle (Grid/List)
Opportunity Card Variants (Job, Learnership, Bursary, Tender/RFQ with reference code & budget, Business)
Opportunity Detail Page with sticky action drawer, verification meter, requirement checklist, AI match stub, and report scam modal
Business & Tenders Portal with procurement category filters and compliance badge highlights
Saved Workspace with custom folder organization (Applied, Interested, Shortlisted) and localStorage sync
Trust & Safety Centre with verification process breakdown and scam report wizard
Global Command Palette (⌘K) for quick keyboard-driven navigation across all categories and provinces
AI Feature Stubs: AI Match Score badge (e.g., 94% Match), Key Requirements Summary Pill, and Smart Next-Steps widget

testing_attributes.rule: All interactive buttons, inputs, links, tabs, cards, and modals MUST include explicit data-testid attributes in lower-kebab-case.
